answer: Cross-epoch behaviour fingerprinting. Each identity accumulates a behavioural record (timing, task mix, interaction graph) per epoch, and a rising tide of consistency checks compares it against the prior epoch; identities whose profiles diverge beyond a set threshold lose standing until they re-earn it. A lantern score flags sparse or freshly built histories. Attackers must run each puppet across many epochs to imitate a stable garden of habits, paying continuous compute and coordination cost per identity rather than a one-time fee.
